name: Tapita AI SEO Blog Builder
summary: AI blog builder for Shopify: generates SEO-oriented posts with titles, images and keyword suggestions, embeds your products, and schedules bulk publishing from a drag-and-drop editor. The Shopify listing published no plan block and no credit allowance when we re-read it on 19 September 2026 — its pricing field reads Free.
best_for: Shopify stores that want structured, product-linked blog drafts and a publishing schedule, and that will edit what comes out before it goes live
skip_if: you intend to bulk-publish AI articles unedited, or you need to know what a tool costs before you install it — as of 19 September 2026 this listing publishes no plan block and no credit allowance at all
honest_knock:
Publishing volume is the trap this tool makes cheap. It generates posts quickly and schedules them daily or weekly in bulk, and a Shopify blog filled with unedited AI articles is precisely the pattern search engines have spent the last two years demoting: the app lowers the cost of production, not the bar for ranking. Used the other way round, as a drafting and structuring tool for posts you actually edit, it is sensible.

The price is the second thing to watch, and on 19 September 2026 there is none to read. The listing publishes no plan block and gives its pricing as Free. That is not the same as free being the whole story: the features it advertises — AI generation, bulk creation, translation, scheduling — were metered in credits until August, and no credit allowance or overage rate is stated anywhere on the page now. The same developer's other listing still prints a complete ladder, so this one is not simply a developer who does not publish prices. Go in expecting to ask what the limits are, and do not plan a content calendar around an allowance nobody has told you the size of.

pricing.notes: (re-read 2026-09-19 on apps.shopify.com/tapita-ai-seo-blog-builder) The paid tier has left the listing. Where the page carried a Pro plan in August, it now publishes no plan block at all: the Pricing field in the header reads simply “Free”, the word Pricing appears exactly once on the whole page, and the only dollar figure anywhere on it belongs to a different app in the “More apps like this” rail. We checked that against the same developer's other listing in the same session — apps.shopify.com/google-seo-schema-meta-data renders its header as “Free plan available” and prints its full ladder — so this is the state of this listing rather than a page that failed to load. What that removes is everything a buyer could previously plan against: Pro at $9.99 a month on Shopify Basic rising to $14.99, $39.99 and $69.99 by Shopify plan, the $101.89 annual rate, the 250 monthly AI credits and the $0.06 charge for each credit beyond them. The free tier's own allowance is gone from the page too — the 50 non-recurring credits are no longer stated — so as the listing stands there is no published number for what the app gives you or what exceeding it costs. Read on the same day: the listing is titled Tapita SEO AI Blog Builder, carries Shopify's “Built for Shopify” badge, works with Shopify Admin and the developer's own Tapita SEO Optimizer & Speed, is offered in English only, and stands at 4.9 from 485 reviews — up from 450 in August — distributed 466 five-star, 13 four-star, 2 three-star, 1 two-star and 3 one-star.
